title: Compose Cluster: OOM Heap & Vim Rescue
summary: Anti-Gravy is down, but this 4-container Docker Compose cluster crashes with Java heap OOM! Reveal `.logs/` with `ls -la`, inspect `.logs/java-api.log`, fix `docker-compose.yml` in `vim`, launch `docker compose up -d`, and scavenge `ram_16gb.dimm` + `gpu_tensor_chip_02.img`.

files.content:
# Open-Weights Telemetry Compose Stack
# BUG: java-api crashes on startup (-Xmx64m)! Raise JVM heap >= 256m (e.g. -Xmx512m) or mem_limit >= 256m.
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: telemetry
      POSTGRES_USER: kiro
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"

  java-api:
    image: eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine
    build: .
    depends_on:
      - postgres
    environment:
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/telemetry
      JAVA_OPTS: "-Xmx64m"
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

  frontend:
    image: node:22-alpine
    depends_on:
      - java-api
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"

  nginx:
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    depends_on:
      - frontend
      - java-api
    ports:
      - "80:80"

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["java", "-jar", "/app/telemetry-api.jar"]

winRules.description: Raise Java heap (`>= 256m`) in `docker-compose.yml` via `vim` and launch `docker compose up -d`
Collect the GPU Tensor Chip (`mv gpu_tensor_chip_02.img ~`)

arrival.text:
[COMPOSE CLUSTER — /srv/kiroween/compose_cluster]
Anti-Gravy is offline, but this 4-container cluster crashed on launch! Finish your briefing with Kiro.d (or click Skip Dialog »).

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa—`docker-compose.yml`, a `Dockerfile`, and no obvious crash log from plain `ls`! Where did the logs go, Kiro.d?

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Use your Tube Transistor: run `ls -la` to expose hidden `.logs/`, inspect `.logs/java-api.log`, then fix `docker-compose.yml` in `vim` (`-c` or interactive) and run `docker compose up -d`!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Found it! `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` -> Exit 137 (OOMKilled)! Someone left `JAVA_OPTS: "-Xmx64m"` on `java-api`!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Open `vim docker-compose.yml` (`i` to edit `-Xmx64m` to `-Xmx512m`, `Esc`, then `:wq`) — or try `docker compose up` first to watch the unfixed pods crash!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: WHOA! All four container sheets launched into mid-air, flickered red, and crashed straight to the floor — Exit 137 OOMKilled!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Zero HP lost, just a wiped pod (`docker ps -a` / `docker prune`). Raise `JAVA_OPTS` in `docker-compose.yml` to `-Xmx512m` via `vim` and re-run `docker compose up -d`!

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: LOOK AT THEM FLY! `[postgres]`, `[java-api]`, `[frontend]`, and `[nginx]` are floating in formation!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Stack online with zero OOMs! Pocket `ram_16gb.dimm` + `gpu_tensor_chip_02.img`, then `cd logic_cell`!
